title: A `tainted` URL at the HTTP client is refused without naming `Core\Http::allowUrl`.
text: ADR 0058's M8 list asks for a `tainted` URL at a client parameter to be a diagnostic naming `Core\Http::allowUrl`. Today it is a bare `E0401`, "expected `string|Core\Http\Target`, found `tainted string`" (`tests/conformance/core/every-client-member-refuses-a-tainted-url.nvst`), and `check_shape_field` attaches a launderer help only at shape-field sinks. The URL sink has one door, which `core_lib.rs`'s roster test pins to `allowUrl`, so the help cannot push the wrong fix. Closing it is that help at every parameter whose type admits `Core\Http\Target`, and the case's expected output naming it.
